beforeWritingUi: Check this manifest before creating UI primitives.
Reuse installed shadcn/ui primitives from @/components/ui or equivalent alias.
Do not recreate standard primitives with raw HTML and ad-hoc Tailwind styling.
If a needed primitive is missing, install it with `npx shadcn@latest add <component-name> --yes` instead of writing a custom replacement.
validation: Run `npm run theme:audit` after UI changes.
